Abelian groups as Z-modules; torsion abelian groups = torsion Z-modules; the total quotient ring of Z is Q
core_obligations: Apply the delivered proposition with A = Z
The Serre subcategory of torsion Z-modules is exactly the torsion abelian groups, and Q(Z) = Q
Hence the quotient category is the category of Q-vector spaces

Match torsion modules with torsion groups and Q(Z) = Q
